validator: Artifact determinism, strict staging, website publication, host ownership, accessibility, production build, and repository audit
outcome: The website mounts approved compiled game modules in its own canvas host without importing demo source.

attempts.disposition: The first verifier looked for the staged URL in the host component instead of the catalog helper that owns it. The corrected assertion passed against unchanged product code.
Missing manifests and symlinks did not always include both the stable code and demo slug. Red regressions now pass with the hardened staging boundary.
Browser Control reported no attached browser. Production build and host/accessibility contracts pass; no browser capture is claimed.
Artifact reproducibility, website production build, delivery tests, strict failures, and the final verifier passed.

acceptance.evidence: Two clean builds compare manifest and entry bytes
Website-owned catalog and explicit publication JSON
Stale, digest, extra-file, symlink, and missing-manifest regressions
Website host source contract for canvas, input, timing, visibility, pause, and disposal
Poster, retry, focus, reduced-motion, and 44-pixel control contracts
54-route Next.js build and three staged demo routes

browserControl.detail: No attached browser was available. No synthetic or native image is presented as browser evidence.

artifacts.purpose: Artifact, staging, publication, host, and evidence facts

afterCompletion.health: Artifact tests, delivery tests, website production build, and repository check
afterCompletion.rollbackTrigger: A website path imports demo source, an unverified file reaches publication, or the host fails to dispose a game instance.
afterCompletion.rollback: Revert the affected staging or website checkpoint and publish the last verified artifact set.
